title: Scottish Enterprise — Economic Development AI Deep-Dive Pack
description: Scottish Enterprise is Scotland's national economic development agency, supporting business growth, innovation, exports, and inward investment. This deep-dive pack maps 12 entry points for AI governance, 8 transformation priorities, 6 MCP servers, and 6 non-negotiable red lines anchored in Scottish economic development legislation and UK subsidy control.
legislation: Enterprise and New Towns (Scotland) Act 1990 / Subsidy Control Act 2022 / Scotland Act 1998 / DPA 2018 / FOI (Scotland) Act 2002 / Equality Act 2010 / Climate Change (Scotland) Act 2009 / Economic Crime and Corporate Transparency Act 2023
